home.lede: Lectures, visits and good company for everyone with an interest in the past.
home.introTitle: One of an international network of branches
home.introLead: The Beckenham and Bromley branch of the Historical Association is one of an international network of branches, and is located in the United Kingdom.
home.intro:
The Historical Association itself was founded in 1906, with the Beckenham and Bromley branch being set up in 1947. The Association is a voluntary organisation for all people, whether professional or amateur historians, who have an interest in the past.

Full details of all events can be found in the branch's monthly bulletin, the Beckenham Historian, which can be obtained directly from the editor at a cost of £10.00 per 10 issues.
events.lede: Thursday evening lectures, guided visits, outings and the occasional fish supper.
events.when: Meetings, as scheduled in the programme, take place on Thursdays at 7.30 p.m. in Beckenham unless otherwise stated. We serve tea and coffee before the meeting.
events.where: All Beckenham lectures take place in Christ Church Hall, Fairfield Road, just off Beckenham High Street, Beckenham BR3 3LE.
events.booking: Email Mrs. Ann Wagstaff, Programme Secretary, to request booking forms.
events.bookingNote: We follow all Government public health guidelines.
membership.lede: The branch is always happy to welcome new members!
membership.intro: If you are interested in joining as a local branch member, you can download the Branch Membership Form or simply complete this form and we will send you details about our branch.
membership.compareIntro: If you wish, you may sign up for full, rather than just local, Historical Association membership.
membership.full: Full HA member — attend meetings at other branches, educational conferences, national and international visits, receive HA publications, use numerous resources on the national website and more besides.
membership.signup: To sign up for full membership, please visit the Historical Association membership page.
bulletin.lede: The complete programme of branch events, plus a selection of history-related articles.
bulletin.intro: The Beckenham Historian is a monthly branch bulletin, containing a complete listing of upcoming branch events as well as a selection of history-related articles.
bulletin.priceLabel: for ten consecutive issues. You don't need to be a branch member to subscribe.
bulletin.subscribe: To register your interest, complete the form or email Mr. John Wagstaff, and we will contact you to arrange your subscription details.
